_comment: CapCut screen-automation coordinates per display resolution (maximized window, 100% scale). Missing resolutions fall back to proportional scaling from reference_resolution - always verify with a real calibration run on a new machine.

1920x1080._measured: N100 (DESKTOP-MU7SH45) 2026-08-13, CapCut 6.8.1.2758, HDMI dummy BBC/HDP-V104, maximized, 100% scale, SIGNED IN.
